purpose: y2s78-thumbcomp2: DIAGNOSTIC Nord2Metal = y2s77-thumbcomp + one line per backboardd composite (every one for the first 400, then 1 in 8): 'PHOTOS BBFRAME n=... target sT c= tl= bl=; reads: sA=... sB=...' = the full-screen target backboardd drew into (3 texels) and the centre of every full-screen surface it read.
